_about: Scholarships Nepali self-funded master's students can actually get, read from each university's own pages (checked 4–14 Oct 2026). kind: nepal = only for Nepal; auto = given automatically to eligible international students; grade = automatic if you reach the UK grade in `min`; considered = every applicant is assessed automatically but awards are limited / at the university's discretion (shown, never counted); apply = you must apply and awards are competitive; early = discount for paying the deposit or fees early; pathway = only via the university's pathway/pre-master's college; partner = only if your bachelor's is from a listed partner institution. amt is the £ value used for cost totals (only nepal/auto/grade awards count towards the 'sure scholarship'). courses limits an award to listed programmes.

University of Exeter.name: PGT Scholarship for Nepal
University of Exeter.note: Automatic for Nepali citizens on an eligible master's (January 2027 list includes MSc Computer Science, Data Science and Advanced Data Science — not Advanced Computer Science). Must meet offer conditions and pay the deposit. Can combine with Exeter Excellence up to £10,000.

University of Exeter.name: Exeter Excellence Scholarship
University of Exeter.note: Competitive, for high-achieving offer holders; apply after getting an offer (January 2027 applications under the 2026/27 scheme until 26 Nov 2026).

Swansea University.name: Nepal and Sri Lanka Thrive Bursary
Swansea University.note: Automatic for students from Nepal — but offered by The College, Swansea University (the pathway / pre-master's college), not for direct MSc entry.

Swansea University.name: Nepal Bursary
Swansea University.note: Automatic £6,000 tuition fee reduction for self-funding students domiciled in Nepal starting a postgraduate taught course — no application. (The research MSc isn't a taught course.)

Birmingham City University.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
Birmingham City University.note: For self-funded international students on a full-time taught master's (listed on BCU's Nepal page).

Coventry University.name: Coventry University Group Scholarship
Coventry University.note: All self-funded international (non-EU) students on full-time taught degrees at UK campuses; no application, but the full CAS deposit must be cleared by the date in your offer.

Edge Hill University.name: Global Vice-Chancellor's Award
Edge Hill University.note: Automatic for international fee-paying students; shown on your offer letter.

Edge Hill University.name: Early payment discount
Edge Hill University.note: Pay full tuition fees before your CAS is issued.

University of Lincoln.name: South Asia Scholarship
University of Lincoln.note: Automatic first-year fee discount for nationals or residents of Nepal (and Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka) on a full-time taught master's starting September 2026 or January 2027 — no application; complete the domicile section of your application. £3,000 with a 2:2 (or equivalent). Only one Lincoln scholarship applies, so it replaces the £2,000 Global Postgraduate Scholarship.

University of Lincoln.name: South Asia Scholarship (2:1 or above)
University of Lincoln.note: The same automatic award rises to £5,000 with a 2:1 or equivalent (September 2026 or January 2027 starts).

University of Lincoln.name: Global Leaders Scholarship
University of Lincoln.note: Competitive; needs a 2:1 or equivalent and an offer. For January 2027 starts, apply by Monday 16 November 2026 (one round); decisions within about 10 working days. Accept and pay the CAS deposit by the date in the award email. Can't be combined with the South Asia Scholarship.

University of Lincoln.name: Advance Full Payment Discount
University of Lincoln.note: Pay the year's fees in full (minus scholarships) by the deadline for your country.

Solent University.name: PGT International Excellence Scholarship
Solent University.note: Automatic for international students with a 2:1 equivalent bachelor's or master's on a full-time master's of 12+ months.

University of Salford.name: Global Gold Excellence Scholarship
University of Salford.note: First-class degree (or equivalent); assessed automatically when you apply. Pay your deposit by the deadline to keep it.

University of Salford.name: Global Silver Excellence Scholarship
University of Salford.note: At least a 2:2 (or equivalent); assessed automatically when you apply. Pay your deposit by the deadline to keep it.

University of Northampton.name: International Scholarship
University of Northampton.note: Merit-based, considered automatically from your application; the amount depends on your academic record (told in your offer letter). Pay £7,000 before CAS to accept.

University of Suffolk.name: International Merit Scholarship
University of Suffolk.note: Automatic for international students who meet or exceed the entry requirements; the amount depends on your grades.

Buckinghamshire New University.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
Buckinghamshire New University.note: Self-funded international students on a full-time postgraduate degree, first year.

Buckinghamshire New University.name: International Early Payment Discount
Buckinghamshire New University.note: For paying fees in full early.

University of Brighton.name: Vice-Chancellor International Scholarship
University of Brighton.note: Automatically applied to eligible international students; can combine with some other Brighton awards (up to £3,500–£5,000 in total at postgraduate level).

Liverpool John Moores Univ..name: International Scholarship
Liverpool John Moores Univ..note: Self-funded international students; considered automatically and confirmed in your unconditional offer. Courses with fees under £17,250 aren't eligible.

Liverpool John Moores Univ..name: Early Payment Discount
Liverpool John Moores Univ..note: All self-funded international students who pay early.

Goldsmiths, Univ. of London.name: International Early Bird Discount
Goldsmiths, Univ. of London.note: Pay the £4,000 minimum deposit by the early-bird date (15 May for September 2026 entry).

Queen's University Belfast.name: South Asia Postgraduate Scholarship
Queen's University Belfast.note: For new students from South Asia on full-time taught master's; check the terms for how it is awarded.

Queen's University Belfast.name: Early Confirmation / full payment discount
Queen's University Belfast.note: Unconditional offer holders who pay tuition in full by the deadline (18 Sep 2026 for taught master's).

Queen's University Belfast.name: International Postgraduate Taught Scholarship (South Asia)
Queen's University Belfast.note: Awarded automatically on enrolment to new full-time international students from South Asia (incl. Nepal) — no application; £4,000 for MSc Artificial Intelligence on the 2026/27 South Asia table.

University for the Creative Arts.name: Full payment discount
University for the Creative Arts.note: Non-EU international students who pay full tuition (after scholarships) before or at CAS issue.

University of Surrey.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
University of Surrey.note: Competitive award for selected postgraduates with academic excellence (listed for Nepalese students; apply by 20 Aug 2027).

University of Surrey.name: International Excellence Award
University of Surrey.note: Self-funded international students; apply before your CAS is issued.

University of Surrey.name: Professor GQ Max Lu Global Scholarship (PG)
University of Surrey.note: For South Asia students on STEM master's with financial need — separate application.

Brunel University of London.name: VC's Postgraduate International Excellence Award
Brunel University of London.note: Competitive; Brunel gives the single highest award you're eligible for.

Brunel University of London.name: Postgraduate International Bursary
Brunel University of London.note: Assessed automatically for self-funded international students with a 2:2 or equivalent on a taught postgraduate course (January 2026 – January 2027 intakes) who pay the £5,000 deposit by the advisory deadline (30 Nov 2026 for January 2027).

Newcastle University.name: Vice-Chancellor's Excellence Scholarship (PG)
Newcastle University.note: 30 awards for outstanding international applicants to full-time master's (listed on Newcastle's Nepal page).

Newcastle University.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship (PG)
Newcastle University.note: International applicants (Nepal listed) are considered automatically on merit — no form; for 2027 entry you must accept the offer and pay the deposit by 2 Aug 2027.

University of Bath.name: Bath Global Excellence Scholarship
University of Bath.note: Up to 250 competitive awards for high achievers on full-time taught master's (Engineering & Design, Humanities & Social Sciences, Science). Deadlines 4 Feb, 8 Apr, 11 Jun 2027.

University of Portsmouth.name: Chancellor's Global Academic Merit Scholarship
University of Portsmouth.note: Merit-based; self-funded international students must complete the scholarship form with their application (January 2027 entry).

University of Lancashire (UCLan).name: Articulation Scholarship
University of Lancashire (UCLan).note: Automatic only if your bachelor's is from one of UCLan's partner institutions in Nepal (see their list).

Leeds Trinity University.name: International Scholarship
courses: MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
Leeds Trinity University.note: Applied automatically to eligible international students in the first year — no application. Listed for Computer Science, Data Science & AI and Financial Technology, not Public Health.

Leeds Beckett University.name: International Student Scholarship
Leeds Beckett University.note: Automatic — no application — for self-funded, full-time students domiciled in Nepal (also the Middle East, Africa and Turkey) paying the overseas fee; deducted from your invoice. Not for PGDip / PGCert, part-time, repeat or placement years. Can't be combined with another Leeds Beckett international scholarship.

Leeds Beckett University.name: Carnegie Sports Scholarship
Leeds Beckett University.note: For student-athletes at a high level in American football, athletics, cricket, football, netball, rugby league, rugby union or tennis; recipients represent the university in BUCS. Apply with your sporting record.

University of Hertfordshire.name: Chancellor's International Scholarship
University of Hertfordshire.note: Your course application is assessed automatically (grades, English, personal statement) — no separate form; the amount is emailed to successful applicants. For new, self-funded international students (stated for September 2026 entry). Not combinable with most other Herts scholarships.

University of Greenwich.name: International Scholarship Award
University of Greenwich.note: Tuition fee discount for new international offer holders; you must fill in the scholarship application form. Criteria and deadlines for January 2027 entry are published from October 2026. Not combinable with other Greenwich awards.

University of Chester.name: International Scholarship Award
University of Chester.note: All international applicants are considered automatically when they apply; any award (amount not published) appears on the offer letter.

Teesside University.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
Teesside University.note: International fee payers on campus are considered automatically but awards are limited and not guaranteed; you must pay the deposit and accept your offer by the date in the email. Stated for September 2026 starts (offer by 30 Apr 2026) — check for later intakes.

University of Sunderland.name: Global Leaders Scholarship
University of Sunderland.note: Postgraduate fee reduction allocated by Admissions — no separate application; shown on your offer letter. Open to international applicants outside East Asia, the Gulf and Europe (so Nepal is eligible) for 2026/27 entry. Not guaranteed and subject to availability.

University of Staffordshire.name: Vice Chancellor's Scholarship
University of Staffordshire.note: Full-time, campus-based international fee payers are considered by International Admissions — no form; shown on your offer letter and CAS. Not for sponsored students; only the highest-value Staffordshire discount applies.

Keele University.name: Postgraduate Global Scholarship (1st)
Keele University.note: Automatic for self-funded international students on a PGDip-or-higher taught course starting 2026/27, by undergraduate result (Keele's own equivalence). One-off; not combinable with other Keele awards.

Keele University.name: Postgraduate Global Scholarship (2:1)
Keele University.note: Automatic with a 2:1 or equivalent (same scheme).

Keele University.name: Postgraduate Global Scholarship (2:2)
Keele University.note: Automatic with a 2:2 or equivalent (same scheme).

University of Worcester.name: International Merit Scholarship (2:1 or 1st)
University of Worcester.note: Automatic for non-EU students on full-time programmes, by academic result. Only one Worcester scholarship can be used (plus the early payment discount).

University of Worcester.name: International Merit Scholarship (2:2)
University of Worcester.note: Automatic with a 2:2 or equivalent (same scheme).

University of Worcester.name: Early payment discount
University of Worcester.note: If you pay the full year's tuition by 30 Sept (September start) or 31 Jan (January start). Can be added to the merit scholarship.

Bangor University.name: International Scholarship
Bangor University.note: All international applicants are considered when they apply (course, grades, statement, references, domicile) — the outcome is in your offer letter. At the university's discretion; not for fully sponsored students.

Aberystwyth University.name: Global Citizens Scholarship
Aberystwyth University.note: Granted automatically to eligible international fee payers who apply by 1 August and meet entry requirements — £3,800 for science subjects incl. Computer Science (£3,000 for humanities / business). Not with external funding (e.g. Chevening).

Aberystwyth University.name: International Accommodation Award
Aberystwyth University.note: Free university accommodation for the full year (50 weeks) of a one-year Master's (September or January start); can be combined with the Global Citizens Scholarship.

University of South Wales.name: International Scholarship
University of South Wales.note: Self-funded international applicants are considered automatically when the application arrives — confirmed in the offer letter. Plus £500 if you're CAS-ready early (31 May for September, 31 October for January/February). Not for sponsored students.

University of Bradford.name: 60th Anniversary Scholarship
University of Bradford.note: Applied automatically as a tuition fee discount (no application, unlimited) for self-funded international students on full-time, on-campus taught master's in 2026/27. Based on nationality — Nepal gets the top rate (£3,200; most other countries £2,200).

Sheffield Hallam University.name: Vice-Chancellor's Award
Sheffield Hallam University.note: Automatic first-year tuition bursary for self-financing students domiciled in South Asia (incl. Nepal) on a full-time taught course, studying at Sheffield Hallam for the first time. Only one award or scholarship can be used.

University of Huddersfield.name: Merit Scholarship (first class)
University of Huddersfield.note: Automatic for self-funding international students on full-time taught courses — notified in your offer letter, every year of the course except placement years.

University of Huddersfield.name: Merit Scholarship
University of Huddersfield.note: Automatic at general entry requirements (minimum 2:2 or equivalent) for self-funding international students; not alongside other scholarships.

Manchester Metropolitan Univ..name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
Manchester Metropolitan Univ..note: Assessed automatically when you apply — no separate application — for international fee payers accepted onto a taught master's (£3,000 for MBA and some architecture courses). Stated for September 2026 entry; check later intakes.

University of Wolverhampton.name: Academic Excellence Postgraduate Scholarship
University of Wolverhampton.note: For all international PGT applicants with a 2:1 or above, deducted from tuition fees (£5,000 for September / November 2026 and January 2027 intakes; £4,000 for others). Privately funded students only.

University of Wolverhampton.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
University of Wolverhampton.note: For international PGT applicants with a 2:2 (or below) — not with the Academic Excellence award. September / November 2026 and January 2027 intakes.

Nottingham Trent University.name: NTU International Merit Scholarship / International Scholarship
Nottingham Trent University.note: Apply with the online scholarship form after getting an offer (January 2027 entry deadline 31 Oct 2026). Country-specific awards listed don't currently include Nepal.

University of East Anglia.name: International PG Merit Scholarship B
University of East Anglia.note: Automatic for Nepal nationals / residents paying overseas fees on an eligible on-campus master's — confirmed shortly after your offer, first year only. £6,500 with a 2:1 or above. Only combinable with the Early Payment Awards; not for fully sponsored students.

University of East Anglia.name: International PG Merit Scholarship B (2:1 or above)
University of East Anglia.note: The same scholarship at the higher rate for a 2:1 or above (UEA's own grade equivalence).

Edinburgh Napier University.name: South Asia Scholarship
Edinburgh Napier University.note: For self-funding students living in Nepal (also India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka) with an offer for a full-time taught master's (June / September 2026, January 2027). Awarded automatically once you pay the deposit, but numbers are limited — not all eligible applicants get it. £1,000 for 2-year courses.

University of Bedfordshire.name: Vice Chancellor's Scholarship
University of Bedfordshire.note: International students on a master's starting in 2026/27 who don't receive another Bedfordshire scholarship get £1,000 off their first-year fees.

University of Bedfordshire.name: Postgraduate Global Merit Scholarship
University of Bedfordshire.note: For international students with at least 75% (or equivalent) in their bachelor's; replaces the Vice Chancellor's Scholarship. Subject-specific merit awards of up to £4,000 exist for listed courses. Plus £1,000 off for paying each year's fees in full by registration.

Middlesex University.name: Regional and International Merit Awards
Middlesex University.note: Apply once you have an offer (conditional or unconditional); for taught undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

University of Aberdeen.name: Aberdeen Global Scholarship
University of Aberdeen.note: Applied automatically to all self-funded, full-time, on-campus international Master's students starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28 — shown on your CAS. Not with full sponsorship or other University of Aberdeen scholarships.

University of Kent.name: Kent International Scholarship
University of Kent.note: Guaranteed tuition fee discount for applicants domiciled in Nepal (and other listed countries) on taught master's outside Kent Business School — no application; you're notified after accepting your offer (January 2027 scheme).

University of Kent.name: Kent International Scholarship (Kent Business School)
University of Kent.note: The same guaranteed discount at £3,000 for Kent Business School taught master's (Global Healthcare Management is a KBS course).

University of Plymouth.name: International Welcome to Plymouth Scholarship
University of Plymouth.note: Offered automatically to any international postgraduate taught student who meets the entry and English requirements in their offer letter. Not for sponsored or online students; one Plymouth scholarship per year.

University of Dundee.name: Global Excellence Scholarship (first class)
University of Dundee.note: For international fee payers with a UK first-class equivalent on a full-time, on-campus master's costing £22,250+ (MSc AI qualifies) — no separate form, verified at offer stage (September 2026 and January 2027 intakes; the 2027/28 scheme is £3,000).

University of Essex.name: Global Talent Masters Scholarship
University of Essex.note: Self-funding international students on eligible courses are considered automatically, based on undergraduate grades (or a passed master's); deducted from tuition fees.

Robert Gordon University.name: International Student Discount for Master's
Robert Gordon University.note: For self-funded international students on a full-time, on-campus master's — no application; shown in your offer letter and applied at enrolment. Nepal (with Kenya and Indonesia) gets £4,000; other countries £3,000. Only one RGU award per programme. Plus £500 off if you pay the deposit early (13 Nov 2026 for January 2027).

De Montfort University.name: Global Access Scholarship
De Montfort University.note: Awarded automatically to international students starting a taught master's in October 2026 or February 2027 who pay the deposit before the deposit deadline. A further £500 if you pay the full fee before that deadline.

UWE Bristol.name: International Student Scholarship
UWE Bristol.note: No application — awarded entirely at the university's discretion to international students on taught courses.

UWE Bristol.name: Postgraduate Success Scholarship
UWE Bristol.note: Automatic once you pay at least £8,500 (£2,500) or the full fee (£3,500) by the deadline (1 Aug 2026 for September 2026). Not with other UWE fee reductions.

Kingston University.name: International Success Support Scholarship
Kingston University.note: Applied automatically to the first-year invoice for international students on listed postgraduate courses only (the list changes by intake) — check whether your course is included.

Kingston University.name: International Merit-Based Scholarship
Kingston University.note: Apply with a 300-word personal statement (January 2027 applications open in early November).

University of Westminster.name: International Postgraduate Excellence Award
University of Westminster.note: For overseas fee payers with an offer for a full-time master's — apply by the intake deadline (30 Nov 2026 for January 2027).

London South Bank University.name: Global Success Scholarship
London South Bank University.note: Given to international students who accept their offer and pay the early deposit by the set deadline; amount depends on subject; first year only.

Glasgow Caledonian University.name: Regional Postgraduate Scholarship
Glasgow Caledonian University.note: Tuition fee discount for Nepali students starting a full-time taught postgraduate course from 2026/27 (Glasgow or London campus) — no separate application, eligibility is assessed with your course application. Not for distance learning, part-time or research courses.

Bournemouth University.name: Academic Excellence Scholarship (International)
Bournemouth University.note: Automatically considered with a 2:1 or first-class degree (or equivalent) for courses starting January 2026, September 2026 or January 2027 — no application. Not for PGDip, part-time or distance learning.

Bournemouth University.name: Academic Achievement Scholarship
Bournemouth University.note: Automatically assessed for applicants with at least a high second-class honours degree (equivalent).

Univ. of the West of Scotland.name: UWS Global Scholarship
Univ. of the West of Scotland.note: Deducted automatically from tuition fees before your CAS is issued if you qualify — Scottish campuses, one-off for taught postgraduate study. Separately, selected programmes have a reduced 'enhanced scholarship' net fee (£13,000 class-based / £15,000 lab-based) with limited places.

University of Stirling.name: Vice-Chancellor's Postgraduate International Scholarship
University of Stirling.note: First-year tuition waiver — 100 awards for September 2026 and January 2027; apply through the 2026-27 application form once you hold an offer. Not with sponsorship or other scholarships.

Abertay University.name: Abertay International Scholarship
Abertay University.note: For new international taught students who meet their offer conditions — you're emailed after your offer if awarded (no form). Honoured if you defer September 2026 / January 2027 starts to the next intake.

Lancaster University.name: Postgraduate International Early Acceptance Scholarship
Lancaster University.note: International taught postgraduates (2027/28 entry) are considered automatically and get £2,000 off if they accept their place by 7 April 2027. Note: the £10,000 International Regional Scholarship included Nepal for 2026 entry, but Nepal isn't on the 2027 list.

Canterbury Christ Church University.name: International Student Scholarship
Canterbury Christ Church University.note: Applied automatically to all full-time international students paying the standard international fee — no application.

Loughborough University.name: Excellence Scholarship
Loughborough University.note: Self-funding international students with a first-class degree (or equivalent) are considered from their application and final result — no separate application (listed for 2027 entry). Other Loughborough awards (Future Leaders £10,000, Global Impact) need an application by the spring deadline.

Oxford Brookes University.name: International Student Scholarship
Oxford Brookes University.note: For postgraduate offer holders who pay the tuition deposit by the deadline linked to their offer date (for September 2026: 13 May, 7 July or 7 August).

University of Roehampton.name: International Excellence Scholarship
University of Roehampton.note: One-year awards for master's students (January or September entry); Roehampton automatically considers conditional offer holders for its Global Excellence award, paid as a fee discount on enrolment.

University of Reading.name: University of Reading Excellence Scholarship
University of Reading.note: Allocated automatically (2026/27) to international fee payers with at least a 2:2 (or expected), based on your academic record — at least £2,000; shown in your offer letter. Offer needed by 12 Dec 2026 for February 2027.

Liverpool Hope University.name: Hope Inspiring Ambition Scholarship
Liverpool Hope University.note: Applied automatically when you receive an offer for any postgraduate programme (except PGCE) as an international student; unlimited. (Business, data science, public health and AI master's get the £2,500 Hope Inspiring Excellence Scholarship instead.)

Bath Spa University.name: International Recruitment Office Scholarship
Bath Spa University.note: International students paying full fees on one-year postgraduate programmes at the Bath campuses are considered automatically once they accept their offer. An Asia Pacific scholarship (excluding China) is also automatic for 2026/27 applications made by 3 August.

St Mary's University, Twickenham.name: Country / Excellence Scholarship
St Mary's University, Twickenham.note: Offer-holders are considered automatically for the first year — Country Scholarship (up to £1,500) for countries on the OECD development list, or Excellence Scholarship (up to £4,000); only one can be held. Full-time, on-campus taught courses starting September 2026 or January 2027.

SOAS University of London.name: SOAS Master's Scholarships (International)
SOAS University of London.note: 150+ fee waivers for overseas fee payers with a 2:1 or equivalent — apply by the round deadlines (2026 rounds: Feb, Apr, Jun). A Nepal / South Asia £5,000 scheme ran in 2023 only.

University of Winchester.name: International Postgraduate Student Scholarship
University of Winchester.note: Automatic for all new international taught postgraduates in 2025/26 (applied to the offer letter) — not yet confirmed for 2026/27 entry; check with Winchester.

University of York.name: Global Impact Masters Scholarship
University of York.note: For 2026/27 entry, eligible international applicants (Nepal listed at £8,000) were considered automatically with their offer — the 2027/28 scheme is 'opening shortly', so confirm with York.

University of York.name: International Masters Achievement Scholarship
University of York.note: Merit-based award for strong international applicants, assessed from your application; limited number.

University of Sussex.name: Sussex Nepal Scholarship (Masters)
University of Sussex.note: Automatic tuition fee reduction for overseas fee payers domiciled in Nepal stated for September 2026 entry — check it's renewed for your intake.

Cardiff University.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
Cardiff University.note: Self-funded international applicants to selected master's courses are considered automatically when they apply — not guaranteed; the eligible-course list is published per intake.

University of Leicester.name: International Postgraduate Merit Scholarship
University of Leicester.note: Automatic for self-funded international students with a first-class degree (or equivalent) on a taught master's — 2026/27 intakes incl. January and April 2027. Not with other Leicester awards.

University of Leicester.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
University of Leicester.note: Competitive — needs a separate application by the published deadline.

Aston University.name: Postgraduate International Community Scholarship
Aston University.note: Applied automatically to self-funded international postgraduate taught students who pay the deposit by the deadline — £3,000 for April 2027 starts (£4,000 was offered for September 2026).

University of Strathclyde.name: Faculty International Masters Scholarships
University of Strathclyde.note: Faculty awards (Engineering, Science, Business) assessed automatically for international offer holders who meet the deposit deadline — Engineering £6,000 for January 2027; not guaranteed.

University of Nottingham.name: International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship
University of Nottingham.note: Automatic for self-funded international students starting a master's in 2026 (replaced the South Asia award) — check the terms for your intake.

Queen Mary Univ. of London.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
Queen Mary Univ. of London.note: International offer holders with a first-class degree (or equivalent) are considered automatically — limited, not guaranteed.

Queen Mary Univ. of London.name: President's Global Scholarship (PGT)
Queen Mary Univ. of London.note: Competitive awards for South Asia incl. Nepal — separate application; the 2026 round is closed, watch for 2027.

University of Glasgow.name: Global Leadership Scholarship
University of Glasgow.note: Competitive tuition fee discount for international master's applicants with a first-class (or equivalent) degree; Nepal is eligible — separate application by the deadline.

University of Greater Manchester.name: International Excellence Scholarship
University of Greater Manchester.note: Merit-based first-year fee discount for international students (2026/27), set from your highest verified qualification and applied at enrolment — not guaranteed. The Global Scholars Awards need a separate application and interview.

University of Law (Leeds).name: International Bursary
courses: MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
University of Law (Leeds).note: Listed off the international fee for courses starting 1 Jul 2026 – 31 May 2027 (£16,500 → £15,000 outside London); terms apply. Not yet shown for 2027/28 starts.

University of Law (Leeds).name: International Bursary (Healthcare Management)
University of Law (Leeds).note: Listed off the international fee for starts 1 Jul 2026 – 31 May 2027 (£17,500 → £15,000 outside London); terms apply.

University of Law (Manchester).name: International Bursary (Healthcare Management)
University of Law (Manchester).note: Listed off the international fee for starts 1 Jul 2026 – 31 May 2027 (£17,500 → £15,000 outside London); terms apply.

York St John University (London).name: Early payment discount
York St John University (London).note: For international taught postgraduate students at the York and London campuses who pay early; most international students pay a 50% deposit first. No automatic international scholarship is listed.
